title: Building your winter composting bay
summary: All the steps to choose the location, measure, drive in the stakes and set up a 3-bay composting area (6.5 × 5 m) in one day.

pages.title: Building a composting bay for living soil
pages.text:
We are going to show you how to set up your composting bay on a bio-intensive market garden farm managed on living soil.

You will build a composting bay made up of **3 compartments** on a **6.5 × 5 m** plot.

The set-up is done in **2 steps**. If all the materials are gathered beforehand, it is a job that takes one person no more than a day.
pages.illustration_description: Vue d'ensemble en aquarelle botanique d'une compostière à 3 compartiments délimités par des piquets de bois locaux et du grillage de clôture, installée sur un terrain dégagé en plein air dans une ferme ouest-africaine.

pages.title: Materials needed
pages.text:
To build the 3-compartment composting bay, gather the following materials:

- **A measuring tape**
- **10 stakes**, 1.30 m high
- **2 lengths of 2 m long by 1.30 m high** fencing mesh

*(Also have a mallet or sledgehammer to drive in the stakes and some wire to attach the mesh.)*
pages.illustration_description: Disposition soignée au sol en aquarelle botanique du matériel de construction : un mètre ruban, un fagot de 10 piquets en bois brut, deux rouleaux de grillage de clôture, un maillet et du fil de fer sur une terre chaude ouest-africaine.

pages.title: Step 1: Choosing your plot carefully
pages.text:
Choose a plot that is **5 m long by 6.5 m wide**. It must be:

- **In the open air**: not covered by a shelter or located under trees.
- **Accessible** by cart or wheelbarrow to make it easier to transport organic matter and compost.

If possible, favor a **raised plot** so that it does not flood during heavy rain. If necessary, level the ground surface.
pages.illustration_description: Un agriculteur ouest-africain avec une brouette inspectant une parcelle dégagée, plane et légèrement surélevée en plein air, loin des arbres, dans un paysage rural sahélien lumineux.

pages.title: Step 2: Dimensions of the 3 compartments
pages.text:
Before driving in the stakes, take the measurements needed to build the composting bay.

Each compartment measures:
- **1.50 m** wide
- **1.30 m** high
- **2 m** deep

A **1 m** path is kept all around the composting bay so you can move around freely.
pages.illustration_description: Schéma en perspective douce à l'aquarelle montrant le tracé au sol d'une zone rectangulaire dégagée avec un chemin périphérique et trois cases égales côte à côte, sans aucun texte ni chiffre.

pages.title: Marking out the perimeter path
pages.text:
1. Start at one end of the plot and measure **1 meter along the depth**. Drive in a first stake.
2. Measure **1 meter along the width**. Drive in a second stake.

This marks out the access path around the composting bay.
pages.illustration_description: Un maraîcher ouest-africain agenouillé sur la terre plane, déroulant un mètre ruban depuis le coin du terrain et plantant les deux premiers piquets en bois pour marquer le chemin autour de la compostière.

pages.title: Marking out the width of the 3 compartments
pages.text:
3. From the second stake, measure **1.5 meters**: this is the width of the first compartment. Drive in a 3rd stake.
4. Repeat this step **two more times** (1.5 m, then 1.5 m) to mark out the second and third compartments of the composting bay.
pages.illustration_description: Alignement régulier de piquets en bois plantés en ligne droite sur le sol nu, délimitant trois largeurs égales côte à côte, tandis qu'un agriculteur ouest-africain enfonce le dernier piquet.

pages.title: Measuring the depth and driving in the second row
pages.text:
5. Go back to the first stake you drove in. Measure **2 meters along the depth**, and drive in a new stake.
6. In the same way, measure the path around the composting bay and the three compartments, driving in the stakes of the second row.

All **10 stakes** are now in place.
pages.illustration_description: Vue en biais à l'aquarelle des deux rangées parallèles de piquets en bois plantés solidement dans la terre, dessinant clairement les 3 compartiments rectangulaires de la compostière.

pages.title: Stretching the mesh between the compartments
pages.text:
7. Stretch the two lengths of **fencing mesh, 2 meters long and 1.30 meters high**, between the central stakes to separate the three compartments of the composting bay.

Secure the mesh firmly to the stakes so that it withstands the pressure of the compost piles.
pages.illustration_description: Une agricultrice ouest-africaine tendant et attachant un panneau de grillage métallique entre les piquets en bois pour créer les cloisons séparant les trois compartiments de la compostière.

pages.title: Congratulations! Your composting bay is ready
pages.text:
**Congratulations!** Your plot now has a 3-compartment winter composting bay, ready for making quality compost for your bio-intensive market gardening on living soil.

Move on to the next module (**M3.3.2**) to learn how to build your layers and succeed with compost fermentation.
pages.illustration_description: Compostière à 3 compartiments achevée en aquarelle lumineuse : piquets robustes et grillages bien tendus, avec une brouette remplie de matières végétales et de paille prête à démarrer le premier tas de compost.
